name: yingzao
title_zh: 实景照片转艺术海报，附原图对比不空想
tagline_zh: 拍过老街、老店、老宅却总出不来高级感？它把照片重排成杂志跨页，还能拼多图场景，附原图对比。别处没有的：连门头招牌的。
tagline_en: Shot real alleys, shops, or heritage sites but got flat results? It re-lays your photos into editorial spreads.
desc_en: Transform real Chinese architecture and place-based cultural photos into art-directed editorial posters, integrated multi-photo scenes, and optional source comparisons. Use for historic buildings, vernacular streets, culturally rooted shops, interiors, food, travel covers, and place montages; do not use for generic advertising, routine retouching, or invented places.
why_zh: 不是滤镜堆叠，而是按建筑类型与地域文化做版式决策：构图、留白、字距都服务于场所精神。
why_en: Not a filter stack—it makes layout decisions per building type and regional culture: composition, whitespace, and letter-spacing.
limit_zh: 只处理真实存在的中国建筑/街景/文化场所照片；虚构场景、纯商业广告、普通磨皮修图它会乱来。输入需是照片而非草图。
limit_en: Only for real Chinese architecture/streets/cultural sites; fictional scenes, generic ads, or routine retouching will misfire. Needs photos (not.
title_en: Real photos into art posters, with source comparison
